engagementSummary.description: DataSkate will design, configure, and deliver a MuleSoft-powered integration connecting HD Portal, Salesforce, ComputerEase, DocHub, GCP, and Deltek — to sync Leads, Jobs, Customers, Contracts, Quotes, Appointments, Tasks, and Payments across 12 confirmed flows. DataSkate manages the MuleSoft runtime, error handling, and monitoring as a fully managed service; Peerless Fence does not own or operate the middleware layer.
engagementSummary.fee: IaaS Managed Service — $3,600/month (12 flows × $300). $7,500 non-refundable retainer at signing, credited against first go-live payment.

paymentSchedule.description: Non-refundable kickoff retainer (11+ flows tier, per pricing model). Credited against the first go-live payment.
First 6-month block ($21,600) minus $7,500 retainer already paid. Billing begins at go-live.
Second 6-month block — full amount. Year 1 total managed service: $43,200 USD.

terms.liabilityCap: 3 months of fees paid by client preceding the claim
terms.subcontractors: DataSkate may use subcontractors with prior written notice to Client. DataSkate remains fully responsible for all subcontractor performance and delivery quality.
terms.confidentiality: Each party will treat the other's confidential information (including this SOW, pricing, and data accessed during delivery) as strictly confidential and will not disclose it to third parties without prior written consent.

ipOwnership.headline: Intellectual Property
ipOwnership.body: Upon receipt of final payment, DataSkate assigns to Peerless Fence all custom integration code, field mapping data dictionaries, and runbooks created specifically for this engagement. DataSkate retains ownership of its pre-existing IP, frameworks, reusable MuleSoft components, and general methodologies. Peerless Fence grants DataSkate a limited license to access Peerless Fence systems solely to perform services under this SOW.

warranty.headline: Warranty
warranty.body: DataSkate warrants that all 12 integration flows will conform to the specifications in Section 2 for 30 days following written UAT acceptance. DataSkate's sole obligation under this warranty is to correct non-conforming flows at no additional charge. This warranty does not cover failures caused by Peerless Fence-side credential revocations, ComputerEase API version changes by Deltek, or HD Portal endpoint modifications by Home Depot after UAT acceptance.

indemnification.headline: Indemnification
indemnification.body: Each party indemnifies, defends, and holds harmless the other from third-party claims arising from its own gross negligence or willful misconduct. DataSkate is not liable for integration failures caused by Deltek API outages, Home Depot Portal credential revocations, GCP infrastructure changes made by Peerless Fence, or ComputerEase data quality issues attributable to client-side configuration.

governingLaw.headline: Governing Law & Dispute Resolution
governingLaw.body: This SOW is governed by the laws of the State of New Jersey, without regard to conflict-of-law principles. Any dispute shall first be escalated to senior management of both parties. If unresolved within 14 calendar days, both parties agree to non-binding mediation before initiating litigation. The prevailing party in any litigation is entitled to recover reasonable attorneys' fees.

dataSecurity.headline: Data Access & Security
dataSecurity.body: DataSkate will access HD Portal, Salesforce, ComputerEase, DocHub, and GCP only to the extent necessary to deliver the services in Section 2. DataSkate will not retain Peerless Fence customer data, job records, or contract documents beyond the engagement. All API credentials will be stored in a SOC 2-audited secrets manager and permanently revoked upon project close or earlier termination. DataSkate will notify Peerless Fence within 48 hours of any suspected unauthorized access to client systems.

forceMajeure.headline: Force Majeure
forceMajeure.body: Neither party is liable for delays or failure to perform caused by events outside its reasonable control, including natural disasters, government actions, or third-party platform outages (e.g. Salesforce infrastructure incidents, Home Depot Portal downtime, Deltek API service interruptions). The affected party will provide written notice within 5 business days and use commercially reasonable efforts to resume performance.

entireAgreement.headline: Entire Agreement
entireAgreement.body: This SOW, together with any signed Change Orders, constitutes the entire agreement between the parties regarding the subject matter herein and supersedes all prior discussions, proposals, and agreements. Amendments require written agreement signed by both parties.

latePayment.body: Invoices unpaid after a 5-business-day grace period accrue interest at 1.5% per month (18% per annum) from the original due date until paid in full. DataSkate reserves the right to suspend managed services if any invoice remains unpaid for more than 15 business days past the due date.

paymentClauses.disputedInvoices: Peerless Fence must notify DataSkate in writing of any disputed line item within 5 business days of invoice receipt. Undisputed portions must be paid in full by the original due date. Both parties will work in good faith to resolve disputes within 10 business days.
paymentClauses.expenseReimbursement: No travel expenses are expected for this engagement. If on-site visits are mutually agreed in writing, pre-approved travel expenses will be billed at cost with receipts, net-30 from submission.
paymentClauses.taxResponsibility: Each party is responsible for its own income taxes. Peerless Fence is responsible for any applicable sales, use, or withholding taxes imposed by its jurisdiction. DataSkate will cooperate in good faith to provide any documentation required for tax compliance.
paymentClauses.workSuspension: DataSkate may suspend managed services with 5 business days written notice if any undisputed invoice remains unpaid more than 15 business days past its due date. The engagement timeline extends by the duration of any suspension.
